importReview: Frontmatter checked for all 724 guides against the cached API records: `name`, `change-record-nid` and `source-url` are present and match the record; `description` and `title` are the record title (no stray entities or whitespace).

`drupal-core` fixed in `import.mjs` (`coreConstraint()`): a record introduced in a patch release now keeps the patch (12 guides, e.g. `>=11.2.5` instead of `>=11.2`), and a record backported to an earlier minor gets an OR constraint (node/3613159: `^11.3.17 || >=11.4`). Records whose version is a branch (`11.2.x`) or a pre-release (`11.2.0-beta1`) keep `>=<major>.<minor>`; node/3359338 has no version and takes its branch (`>=11.0`).

Categories: the old rules also matched the first 400 characters of the body, so a passing mention of a node, theme or test decided the folder. The rules in `import.mjs` now match the title only, are ordered from specific to broad, and a small `CATEGORY_OVERRIDES` map (nid to category) handles 34 titles that no rule can place well. 203 guides moved; the rerun deleted their old folders and `manifest.json` lists the new paths.
`import.mjs --list` prints nid, category, core constraint and title for review without writing anything.
No guide has an empty body; the shortest bodies are listed below with the link-only and no-replacement notices. Nothing was deleted and no guide text was changed.
After the rerun, `npm run validate` in `engine/` passes (827 guides).

Benchmark tasks: every in-scope record (introduced at or before the base app's Drupal 11.4.13) has either a calibrated `cr-*` task or a one-line "no task" reason below. Each task was calibrated with `npm run bench:calibrate` in `benchmarks/`: the reference solution passes every check, the untouched base app fails every MUST check and passes every MUST NOT check, and the re-grade from the reference diff agrees. No benchmark trial or model call was run.
